extensionContract.note: Extension lists mirror src/application/src/MediaPaths.cpp; the manifest records the current contract so a changed filter is visible against these fixtures.

reproducibility: Image encodings use fixed Pillow parameters and contain no wall-clock metadata; they are byte-identical with the same Pillow/zlib/libjpeg/libwebp/libtiff builds. The ffmpeg commands pass -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact as output options; two runs with the same FFmpeg build were verified byte-identical. A different FFmpeg build may produce different video bytes. generationDate is the only run-dependent manifest value.
license: All fixtures are synthetic test patterns generated by this script; no third-party image or video content is copied into the repository.

fixtures.generationCommand: Pillow Image.save(format='PNG') of a deterministic 16x16 RGB image
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg PNG decoder handles 8-bit RGB; StillImageDecoder sniffs the PNG signature; .png is in the application still-image extension list.

fixtures.generationCommand: Pillow Image.save(format='PNG') of a 16x16 I;16 gradient (PNG colour type 0, bit depth 16)
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg PNG decoder reports gray16be; StillImageDecoder preserves sourceBitDepth=16 and creates an RGBA64 sidecar, while the display buffer stays RGBA8.
FFmpeg MJPEG decoder handles the JPEG stream; .jpg is in the still-image extension list. Encoded pixels are lossy, so tests assert dimensions/format, not exact colours.

fixtures.generationCommand: Pillow Image.save(format='BMP') of a deterministic 16x16 RGB image
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg BMP decoder handles uncompressed 24-bit BMP; .bmp is in the still-image extension list.

fixtures.generationCommand: Pillow Image.save(format='GIF') of a 16-colour P-mode image; exactly one frame
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg GIF decoder handles the single frame; .gif is in the still-image extension list. Recognising GIF must not imply animation or image-sequence playback support.

fixtures.colorType: RGB8 (lossless WebP; ffprobe decoder output argb)
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg WebP decoder handles the lossless still image; .webp is in the still-image extension list. Animation/multi-frame semantics are out of scope.

fixtures.generationCommand: Pillow Image.save(format='TIFF', compression='tiff_deflate') of a 16x16 RGB image
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg TIFF decoder handles 8-bit RGB; .tif/.tiff are in the still-image extension list. Multi-page semantics are out of scope.

fixtures.generationCommand:
Hand-written P6 PPM: ASCII header 'P6
16 16
255
' plus 768 raster bytes
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg PPM decoder receives AV_CODEC_ID_PPM; StillImageDecoder sniffs the 'P6' magic; .ppm/.pnm are in the still-image extension list.

fixtures.generationCommand: first 96 bytes of png_rgb8_16x16.png (partial IDAT, no IEND)
fixtures.expectedBehavior: The PNG signature is present, so StillImageDecoder selects the PNG decoder, but IDAT is incomplete and IEND is absent. FFmpeg and Pillow both fail; the expected result is a clear load error, and a failed load must not replace the committed pair/session.

fixtures.generationCommand: byte-for-byte copy of jpeg_rgb8_16x16.jpg renamed to a .png extension
fixtures.expectedBehavior: Entry routing is extension-based and accepts .png, while StillImageDecoder sniffs the JPEG SOI marker, so the current decoder treats these bytes as MJPEG. The fixture records extension/content mismatch; tests must assert the chosen behaviour instead of assuming extension equals content.

fixtures.generationCommand: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x48:rate=30:duration=0.4 -frames:v 12 -an -c:v libaom-av1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 35 -b:v 0 -cpu-used 8 -row-mt 1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact <output>/av1_64x48_30fps_12.mkv
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg decodes AV1/yuv420p (12 frames, 30 fps). CompareStation MediaProbe rejects AV1 because the accepted codec set is H.264/HEVC/MPEG-4 Part 2, so the expected result is kUnsupportedCodec. .mkv is an accepted video extension, so this rejection is reachable through normal entry routing.
fixtures.currentGate: MediaProbe.cpp codec gate: AV1 is not H.264/HEVC/MPEG-4 Part 2 → kUnsupportedCodec
fixtures.entryFilter: .mkv is in the video extension list (.mp4/.mkv/.mov/.avi/.m4v)

fixtures.generationCommand: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=64x48:rate=30:duration=0.4 -frames:v 12 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 40 -b:v 0 -cpu-used 8 -row-mt 1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact <output>/vp9_64x48_30fps_12.webm
fixtures.expectedBehavior: FFmpeg decodes VP9/yuv420p (12 frames, 30 fps). MediaProbe rejects VP9 with kUnsupportedCodec. The container is .webm, which is not in the application video extension list (nor the still-image list), so normal entry routing rejects the file before the codec gate; the codec gate can be observed by probing the stream directly.
fixtures.currentGate: MediaProbe.cpp codec gate: VP9 is not H.264/HEVC/MPEG-4 Part 2 → kUnsupportedCodec; entry routing also rejects .webm
fixtures.entryFilter: .webm is not in the video extension list and not a still-image extension
